answer: Require each identity to escrow a 620-unit bond and serve a thirty-two epoch probation. Each round it completes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for thirteen rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm locks 620 units per alias and replays thirty-two rounds, while a lantern of correlated traces exposes the ring, harbor-sealed receipts certify reviews, and velvet markers track honest provenance.
